recent.author: Mollie Walker

recent.text: #NYR captain J.T. Miller gave Buffalo a lot of credit, but also acknowledged how his line was on for three goals against tonight: "If we're better, the game's tighter. I think that's it's hard to speak on behalf of the team too much when, you know, our assignment beat us 3-0. We

recent.text: J.T. Miller said the #NYR are "having a hard time finding the back of the net." He felt the Rangers had their chances tonight but added, "It seems like when we play these dynamic, offensive teams that like to play on the move, we let them play on the rush a little too much."
recent.author: Peter Baugh

recent.text: #NYR Adam Fox: "I thought we, especially early, kind of just let them come through the neutral zone a little untouched. 4-on-3's, 3-on-2's, 2-on-1's, and they're a skilled team they're going to make you pay. We had some looks, but I thought we just made the game too easy for
recent.author: Mollie Walker

recent.text: Vladislav Gavrikov on the Sabres first goal: "Just happened fast. Lost the puck on the blue. Obviously there was a four-on-two, four-on-three rush. They executed well. So it's hard to tell because it happened fast, so I've got to rewatch that."
recent.author: Peter Baugh

recent.text: #NYR Vladislav Gavrikov on the Sabres scoring 17 seconds into the first shift of the game: "It happened fast. It was a turnover, obviously, gotta rewatch that. But it was an odd-man rush, they executed well. Again, have to rewatch that to see what's up."
